runtime_issue.symptom: Planner bridge intermittently blocked on BOARD_READ_ERROR while reading docs/operations/orchestrator/parallel-workstreams.json.
runtime_issue.root_cause: board_lock hashed the raw target path, so callers using the runtime workboard path and callers using the projected docs path acquired different lock files for the same logical board.

fix.summary: Canonicalize projected orchestrator paths before deriving the shared lock path so runtime and docs readers/writers serialize on one lock.

verification.tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s platform/automation/tests -p 'test_orchestrator_paths.py' -> OK (8 tests)

unblock.detail: Runtime truth is healthy again; BATCH-24 remains constrained only by its expected WAITING_DEP downstream batch.
